regimeSub: BOK board splits hawkish as Korea core inflation diverges from Fed paralysis; chip rally masks real economy trap.

Warsh 'facts over forecasts' framework (Jul 30) with 3 dissents for hike leaves Fed rudderless → VIX at 15.81 complacent vs inflation-growth mismatch; gold at $4357 reflects real asset bid
